The '''''Fleen''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. [[Jer Blankuna]] arranged for the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to bring a group of adventurers to his [[Alderaan orbital mansion|mansion]] orbiting [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="G2" />
